worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.summary: Skitter low around behind the target and strike from its back with a chitinous limb: contact damage that lowers the target's Sp. Atk. A strike from behind hits harder; the skimming form cuts the corner for a faster hit but loses the backstab bonus.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.use.0: Slip around a guard from the flank
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.use.1: Punish a foe that is busy attacking someone else
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.use.2: Sap the Sp. Atk of a special threat
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.descripti: Deals %1$s contact damage to the target; a strike from behind raises it by %2$s.
On a hit the target loses %1$s stage(s) of Sp. Atk.
Reach %1$s blocks; the skittering arc is %2$s blocks and it settles %3$s blocks behind the target.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.option.on: Deep flank: it travels to the target's true back for the backstab bonus, at the cost of +1 tick wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.option.of: Skimming: it cuts past the target's side for a faster hit, but strikes from the flank and gains no backstab bonus.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.growth.0: From level %1$s the smack rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.growth.1: From level %1$s the skittering arc extends to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.skittersmack.preferenc: On: it travels a wider arc to the target's true back for the backstab bonus, at +1 tick wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: it skims past the target's side, striking faster but from the flank without the backstab bonus.
It only picks a skittering strike when the target is within this distance; beyond that the shared approach handles the gap. Larger values start the run earlier.
